mixerBenchmarksNote: The isolated fixtures call the granular kernel on a UI tick. The maximum includes interrupt preemption. The minimum of eight readings per case helps compare the loops. These timings and elapsed whole-frame time during USB capture measure different work.
compactLoop: One frame per loop, fractional step in an address register. Four-sample experiment reads the fractional step from the stack. Both retain six voices, the 35-point price and the stock frame guard.
guardSemantics: The base may substitute silence for a module render when its predicted cost exceeds available frame credit. Stock Flex runs directly. Capture timestamp gaps, MIDI errors and substituted renders are independent counters.
